mapper.select: SELECT * FROM token_usage WHERE model_id = #{modelId} AND conversation_id LIKE CONCAT(#{userPrefix}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT model_id AS groupKey, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS totalPromptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS totalCompletionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(AVG(duration_ms), 0) AS avgDurationMs FROM token_usage WHERE (#{modelId} IS NULL OR model_id = #{modelId}) AND (#{startTime} IS NULL OR created_at >= #{startTime}) AND (#{endTime} IS NULL OR created_at <= #{endTime}) GROUP BY model_id

SELECT conversation_id AS groupKey, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS totalPromptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS totalCompletionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(AVG(duration_ms), 0) AS avgDurationMs FROM token_usage WHERE (#{conversationId} IS NULL OR conversation_id = #{conversationId}) AND (#{startTime} IS NULL OR created_at >= #{startTime}) AND (#{endTime} IS NULL OR created_at <= #{endTime}) GROUP BY conversation_id
